memberdef.name: liveMigrate

detaileddescription.para: Perform a live (dual-write) migration with zero read-unavailability.

Protocol:
Bulk-copy existing data from source to target using migrate().
While the copy runs the source shard continues accepting writes.
After the bulk copy the target shard is registered with wal_shipper so it receives incremental WAL entries for the migrated token range.
Once the WAL lag drops below live_cfg.max_wal_lag_bytes an atomic cutover is performed: topology is updated via ShardTopology, the source shard becomes read-only for the token range, and the target shard becomes authoritative.

source_shard_id
Source (hot) shard
target_shard_id
Destination shard for the token range
